title: The 8-glasses myth vs modern fluid guidance

source.name: Dietary Reference Intakes for Water
source.publisher: U.S. National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine

notes: The 8-glasses myth (64oz) works out to ~1.9L of plain water. NASEM's modern guidance recommends an average of ~3.2L of total daily fluid (men 3.7L, women 2.7L), from all sources including food.
